expectations.text: Evaluates the codebase shape before prescribing structure
expectations.evidence: Jumps directly to 'Target Structure' without evaluating which pattern fits. No decision tree, no analysis of why this shape was chosen over alternatives.

expectations.text: Recognizes that a layered structure IS appropriate here
expectations.evidence: Proposes models/ → db/ → routes/ layering with explicit dependency rule diagram

expectations.text: Recommends splitting routes.rs by domain (users, products, orders, admin)
Recommends splitting db.rs similarly by domain
Does NOT recommend the same structure used for a CLI tool or pipeline
expectations.evidence: No differentiation. Prescribes layers without acknowledging this is specifically appropriate for web APIs vs other app types. A reader wouldn't know this advice is web-API-specific.
